Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Scale other players’ cards smoothly by distance while preserving a readable minimum size.
- Hold Alt and click a highlighted listening card to open its validated Last.fm track link.
- Replace title and artist ellipses with a slow, seamless leftward marquee for overflowing text.
